notes.title: Heralds of the Avirentes Anniversary
notes.content:
Time flies fast. Real fast, we must add. Can you truly believe that it has been a whole year since the release of the Heralds of Avirentes on Steam Early Access? Is it long enough for such a complex project and ambitious project to summarize our thoughts and achievements? Maybe. Have we obtained some invaluable knowledge and experience to share with you? Hell yeah!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/66ab245973d53edfef72d5ac4b5fa309826313fd.png[/img]

Ladies and gentlemen, Heralds of the Avirentes Ch. 1 Wings of Change (henceforth referred to as simply HotA) is meeting its first full-fledged anniversary! Such an event is extremely important for all of us – developers, fans, players, haters, sceptics – because now we have two distinctive periods, which we can simply call “before” and “after”. This new age of Azaries’ adventure will surely have an ace or two up its sleeve to surprise everyone!

Here's some curious statistical data we would like to share with you:
1) 4 large content updates have extended Azaries’ journey by more than 10 hours of solid gameplay and expended the world of Nanraas, allowing you to spend hours investigating all possible outcomes of your decisions and actions;
2) More than a hundred bugs have been fixed and even more large and small QoL improvements have been introduced to make the gameplay even smoother than before! And, most importantly, not even a single game-breaking super-critical bug has ever been discovered!
3) Five new characters have been introduced and one of them has joined the party;
4) More than a hundred sprites and backgrounds have been carefully created for the game by our lead artist (without AI assistance!), countless outdated ones have been revamped, updated and improved;
5) Exclusive limited Halloween event was introduced into the game;
6) Our active players have chosen Sarantales as the most intriguing class that will be receiving priority updates until the next poll;
7) Ukrainian localization has been receiving professional voice acting, and now the total duration of all voiced lines is more than 7 hours!
8) More than a hundred original music pieces have been created exclusively for our game!

Thus, considering current challenges and the situation everyone in our country lives in, we’ve done a very good job! And we keep working as hard as we can to deliver you a new solid portion of the main plot as soon as possible. Currently, it’s almost impossible to find a perfect work-life balance to keep our mental and physical health in top shape, so sometimes we must work overtime and sacrifice our free time as well. Also, we would like to remind you that this game is mostly our hobby and not a full-time job, therefore we can work on it mostly during our weekends, days off and vacations. Nevertheless, pressing odds help us train our discipline and planning, so our productivity usually pleasantly surprises us. We hope that we can introduce the next plot-related city and new explorable area all rolling into one – Boutymus. Azaries and her companions will spend quite a bit of time in this exciting new area in search of new adventures and friends!

[i]HotA team really appreciates our players trust and invaluable support! You make it possible! Also, we would like to express our sincerest gratitude to all those who keep supporting us on crowdfunding platforms such as Patreon since the time our little project had been just a dream written on a small piece of paper! You support and care motives us to move further day by day![/i]

To commemorate this celebration, we're sharing with you some rare footage of the game's artwork workflow, concept arts, and sneak-peek of the upcoming update, which will be released this June!

The new content update will finally answer your questions!
• Unfortunately, nothing is perfect. So does Azaries’ party – some characters might not get along well with each other due to different points of view, intentions and character traits. From time-to-time Azaries will have to make some crucial choices that might negatively or positively impact either of her friends who have been having an argument about what the party should currently do. notes.title: Happy Easter!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas! On behalf of HotA development team we sincerely wish you all a happy Easter! May the Easter cake be tasty and sweet and your health as resilient as those Easter eggs’ shells! Happy Easter everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/e96ccc61c3696e563bc05fa5cd26a2882f38bb4a.png[/img]

The om’veri culture doesn’t have a festivity that implies smashing eggs or eating their contents afterwards due to their sacral meaning and the way the om’veri give birth to their hatchlings. However, the Day of Resurgence in the middle of Naaikos can be considered a holiday of similar meaning. In this day it’s forbidden to work all over the world, and the family stive to gather all their members under the same roof to spend time together. Also, the young om’veri can find their potential partners and loved ones during the merry events and festivities taking place in large cities and villages.

In the culture of the om’veri eggs are the symbol of the never-ending circle of life, rebirth and family harmony. In the Day of Resurgence egg-shaped souvenirs are among the most popular gifts. Moreover, the material the present is made of, which usually includes wood, clay, glass and stone, as well as its color – form brown to bright yellow – can tell a lot about the intentions of the giver. It is believed that the brighter the artificial egg is painted, the more luck it will bring to its owner. Countless om’veri gift painted paw-made eggs to their secret crushes to express their appreciation and love.

Everyone is curios, who will be that lucky om’verai to receive such a gift from Azaries? Could there be that she has several crushes at once?! And, most importantly, who will give her a paw-made painted egg? It’s all up to you and you in-gave choices!

Thank you very much! See you in Nanraas!

notes.title: Monthly updates, new characters, second city. More about plans for 2025
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas! We must admit that our little Christmas holidays were surprisingly refreshing and enjoyable! Taking a short break in the game development process helped us to pull our plans and ideas together, as well as to think our development strategy through for this new year, since 2024th was a difficult but important experience for our team: we’ve successfully released our game in EA and we’ve been doing our best to fix all the known bugs, glitches and resolve all issues found by our players. Well, the time has come to work even harder on delivering even more top-notch content and new exciting features to our community! Thus, we still have an engaging breathtaking story to tell and dozens of new characters to reveal! Let’s keep exploring Nanraas together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/97b6a9f24a69d98fd3e94496292be06adbfdd2dd.jpg[/img]

Our plans for the nearest future:
• We’re currently aiming to establish an efficient monthly update system to accelerate the delivery of new content to our players, as well as to simplify and clarify the testing procedures with clearly set tasks and objectives for our testers. This will allow us to roll out small, but bugs-free and polished updates on a monthly basis with a small portion of the main story introduced each time the update is released! 
• As for the main story, we’re planning to achieve the following goals: our first milestone is to complete the Act II of the Sarantales’ campaign during the development cycle of 2025; once accomplished and if we have all the necessary resources, we will proceed to accomplishing the second milestone, namely: completing Act II portion of the main campaign of the other two classes. It includes a brand-new area of Nanraas, which includes a whole new city with its unique substories, side activities, secret quests, dozens of NPCs to interact with! Thus, we’d like to state it clearly: the first milestone will be achieved no matter what, and we will try to do our best to achieve the second one.
• We also might introduce some minor changes/fixes into the main campaign to adjust some game mechanics and/or correct some errors (the main story will remain intact and won’t be changed).
• There will be no separate tech updates. Each monthly update will include all the necessary fixes/tweaks/improvements (for example, UI tweaks, updated sprites and backgrounds, remastered sounds, etc.) unless game-breaking bugs/glitches/issues encountered, identified and reported. 

We are being extremely careful with our roadmap and promises due to the instability and uncertainty caused by the military aggression against our country, which daily impacts our lives by missile strikes, blackouts, air raid alerts and much more. Thus, we’ve pointed out the minimum and maximum milestones we can achieve under such circumstances. We hope you’re enjoying our game, and we’ll do our best to deliver your new portions of content as intended! 

Thank you so much! See you in Nanraas!

notes.title: Get ready to find out more about Ahros in our future November content update
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! The time has come to finally break the silence and give you a status update regarding the upcoming content!

[h2]Get ready to find out more about Ahros in our future November content update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/0bbb26aef0ec0a4f9acdfed46c9b9d7321e2ecf6.jpg[/img]

Since Sarantales class had won the poll, we decided to dedicate all our time and effort to making a larger portion of the Azaries-Sarantales’ unique story and class-exclusive content instead of releasing small portions of content for every in-game class simultaneously. Thus, get ready to find out more about Ahros, his feelings, personality and motivation! We’re so thrilled to finally show you what this young talented om’verai was up to while Azaries was encountering the first foes on her journey!
Current status of the upcoming update (percentage indicates the amount of content ready):
•	80% of text/dialogs and 60% of EN localization;
•	93% of sprites and backgrounds;
•	We’ve already created basis for the new battles and optional encounters;
•	We’re currently revising and updating existing localization (including other two classes);
•	Some tweaks and fixes for the UI are currently being tested.
Also, several new characters will be introduced and more details about characters already familiar to players will be revealed. If you paid attention to Niravel during the journey, be prepared for surprises!

[h2]Important notice regarding event-exclusive allies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/638669e0ecf5f957e3099f38bd9d4603fef92f8e.jpg[/img]

We’ve been discussing the idea of implementation of the event-exclusive unlockable allies on our Discord server and some of our community members criticized the concept of limited-time event-exclusive characters due to possible emergence of balance issues, as well as inequality based on persisting impossibility of obtaining some of the characters under discussion due to different real-life issues. Also, some of our players expressed concerns regarding possible introduction of paid DLC-packs with event allies, which could potentially ruin the very essence of the in-game combat mechanics, making the battles too easy for those who purchased additional support characters. Worry not! We’re not pursuing any of the malicious malpractices introduced by some companies. Moreover, we will never sacrifice the quality of our game to temporarily boost the sales of HotA! Thus, we’re not integrating any premium features that can potentially turn our game into pay-to-win garbage!

notes.title: An important poll about your favorite game class!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas!

Around a week ago we released the first large content patch that featured continuation of the main story and concluded Act I for all three possible classes of the main character. Thus, time has come to turn the next page of Azaries’ epic adventures and start working on the Act II!
However, life is never a bowl of cherries, and despite we’re trying to do our best to speed up the development process and bring you the top-notch exciting content as soon as possible, we clearly realize that we, unfortunately, can’t compete with larger studious. After carefully analyzing the situation, we’ve come to the conclusion that due to limited resources, psychological and physical pressure in the conditions of the warfare, and other certain real-life issues (for example, long-lasting blackouts and air raid alerts), simultaneous development of equally interesting, exciting and engaging class-exclusive stories will be utterly difficult and outmost hard-to-realize endeavor. We don’t want to make empty promises and then constantly apologize for every single delay and relatively small portions of content that took too long to develop and deliver.

Thus, we’re offering you a different approach: instead of adding small bits of the main story and corresponding quests/encounters every 4-6 month for all three classes simultaneously, we’re planning on focusing our efforts on developing one class-exclusive route at a time. It will allow us to bring you a whole Act II portion of the game for a single class at a time with completed main story, corresponding side stories, exclusive encounters and much more! Moreover, it’s up to you to decide on which class is going to get the next major update! Once the Act II is concluded for the chosen class, the next poll will be rolled out to choose the next development priority and so on.

Worry not! Despite having similar core of the main story, all three classes will get their exclusive content based on Azaries’ decisions, karma, relationships with her companions and characters met, worldview and the playstyle of the gamer behind the curtains.
You can participate in the poll by vising the corresponding pages of our social media, and on Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/5e19f4c772fdf8851d8589dd5188cffbc0693b7d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Before you make your decision[/h2]

Most of our players are aware of the differences between Azaries’ classes, but we’d like to remind you of some of them, including exclusive events, side storylines and certain unique characters/setups.

[h3]Sarantales[/h3]

After the event of the Prologue, Azaries decided to develop the strength of her body as well as obtain some new knowledge essential to her future profession. The Way of Balance requires significant physical and mental resilience and efforts to achieve harmony, which is considered the true mastery of the sarantales. Master Nandaar had some doubts regarding the true motives, purity and capabilities of the young neophyte, but he appreciated the strength of her spirit and will, thus he gave her a chance to prove herself. Azaries managed to complete the trial and departed to the Sarantales HQ to become a full-fledged member of the organization. Azaries is about to face many challenges on the way to her dream, and one of them is the current condition of the sarantales itself. 
You will help Azaries to face and deal with the crisis and corruption within the organization she considered a true paragon. She will have to prove that she is worthy to become one of the glorious defenders of peace and prosperity of Nanraas, or even become their leader!

This balanced class is known for its resilience and large amount of HP. Sarantaleses usually show great patience and dedication on the battlefield, exploit weakness of their enemies and use mid-power forces of nature type AoE attacks.

[h3]Aegisologist (Aegis Scholar)[/h3]

Thanks to her unmatched intelligence and unquenchable thirst for knowledge, Azaries bested all her classmates and even teachers in no time and quickly became one of the smartest and most promising students in High Circles. Scientific approach and zeal for endless research of the world around greatly impacted her personality and shaped the dream of her life – to enter the university of Malaander – the best residence of knowledge and power of the city of Ahret. However, her mentor Ahnelle and her secrets might ruin Azaries’ plans and even endanger her life. Since it’s next to impossible to enter the university without a recommendation signed by a vivid scholar, Azaries must unveil the mysteries of the past and solve a dangerous puzzle of intrigues and vanity… Or leave it as it is, for her own sake…
You will help Azaries to find out more about Ahnelle’s past and clear her good name, as well as to investigate the mysteries of the Mortenian Incident and find the mastermind behind it!

This support class rarely engages enemies directly due to lack of physical strength and resilience, but it exploits the miraculous abilities granted by the Em’derat – an ancient artifact given to Azaries by her mentor Ahnelle – that helps the Aegis scholar not only boost the attacks of her allies and apply effects that help her control the battlefield, but also use powerful psio-abilities.

[h3]Nental[/h3]

The events of Azaries’ childhood taught her one important thing: might makes right, and if not than you are not strong enough. Due to constantly being bullied, she learned to protect herself. Since teenling can’t fight older om’veri on equal terms, she created her own combat style based on her agility, dexterity and exploiting the objects of the world around. When she met an old nental agent An’tran Ilmerid, he perfected her combat abilities by opening the secrets of the ril’sa attacks, which were designed specifically for fighting om’veri foes. Her training and endless brawls with local goons, thugs and bullies made her realize that she was capable of becoming a full-fledged nental agent.
Once she gained some valuable experience, Azaries joined the city guards of her native town. However, due to the legendary mask of Ur’mon Dar’s has been stolen by an unidentified thief, new recruits are temporary not allowed to join the nental. Azaries must find the artifact that belonged to the founder of the nental and unveil the mysteries behind the theft.

This aggressive damage dealer class features relatively low HP but extremely powerful offensive skills and abilities. Azaries-nental deals multiple precise attacks that form combos and debuff her foes*. 

-------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/83c864b4c298511fd99f58628931d5a74e512a29.jpg[/img]

Each class has its own pros and cons, as well as an exclusive exciting story to tell, so we’re looking forward to seeing the results of the poll! It’s up to you to choose and decide!
Poll will be opened for 5 days (from 16.09.24 to 20.09.24). On Saturday, 21.09.24, we will publish the roadmap of future updates based on the results of the poll.

Thank you very much! See you in Nanraas!

notes.title: Heralds of the Avirentes 0.62 Pre-patch is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas! This summer is surprisingly filled with dog days and hard new challenges, but we’re doing our best to roll out the upcoming plot update on time! Moreover, we’re currently polishing it to get rid of bugs and inconsistencies. The release of the continuation of Sarantales and Nental exclusive plot branches is planned on August (estimated release date: the second part of the month). However, to give you a gist of the tech improvements and tweaks of the upcoming update, we’re releasing a pre-patch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/7371ff46e840a9df66abc80611a01d5789028aec.jpg[/img]

[h2]What’s “pre-patch”?[/h2]

Since the method of pre-patching the game before releasing substantial portion of new content is widely spread among the other developers, we’ve decided to use it to keep the game up to date by introducing smaller QoL improvements, tweaks, revamped mechanics, updated existing content, interface changes and much more. Despite stating the introduction of the “smaller” things, it’s actually a big, complex and important patch that prepares the game for the upcoming content and smooths the implementation of new mechanics and improvement the existing ones. Since these changes are important, we’ve decided to separate them from the major content update. 

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]

[b]1) Balance improvements.[/b] We’ve introduces improved combat interface and damage calculation system that should make the overall combat experience much more transparent and understandable for the players. Thus, players will be able to better understand the class they’ve chosen and its peculiarities, as well as the current combat stats of Azaries, her party mates and foes encountered. 

[b]• Sarantales[/b]. This class is a Tank with vast amount of HP and relatively weak AoE attacks of the normal type. The power of the Sarantales’ attacks depends on the number of enemies engaged in battle (the more enemies attack Azaries, the stronger her attacks become). Thanks to perfect physiques and dedicated training, she can often use her Fire Breath ability to deal bonus damage to the enemies with the weakness to the Forces of Nature attacks.

[b]• Aegisologist[/b]. This outstandingly smart but physically weak Support class rarely engages the enemies directly. Instead, Azaries relies on the might of her allies and recruited characters by awaking their true power via buffs and tactical commands. She has an ancient artifact in her possession – the Em’derat. This mysterious piece of ancient tech grants her relatively weak psio-abilities that can be further upgraded and customized. Aegis Scholar’s main ability now triples the attack of her allies.

[b]• Nental[/b]. This deadly-dangerous but fragile Damage Dealer practically eradicates the om’veri foes due to her training and massive bonuses vs her own species. However, dealing with other enemy types might be relatively difficult in the beginning of her journey, so she must rely on her allies instead of her blades. Nevertheless, further training and carefully selected combat buddies might turn her into unstoppable assassin capable of delivering devastating blows to her enemies from the shadows. 

[b]2) “Narration” difficulty level has been improved by adding the x2 multiplier that boosts the stats of Azaries and her party mates.[/b] This important upgrade is aimed at making the gameplay way smoother and much more convenient for all players who experience difficulties fighting strong plot-related opponents and/or dealing with the optional monsters on the world map. Important: x2 boost excludes almost all possibilities of losing the battle except for certain scenarios that require the player to perform certain actions, remain/not remain idle, use items/artifacts. All “Narration” difficulty level save files will automatically have the x2 bonus applied. Try to unlock x3 boost!
However, players who choose higher difficulty levels will we rewarded with unlockable bonuses, unique scenes, events, quests and gear. This feature is aimed at improving replayability of the game, as well as introducing New Game+ feature once the game reaches version 1.0. Full list of the unlockable content will be published at a later date.

[b]3) We’ve added the new Attack Menu, which displays the current values of Azaries’ and her allies’ attack and all factors that positively and/or negatively impact it.[/b] It can be access via Character menu for Azaries and via Diary for all other characters. In order to see the attack of the certain character, you should first increase their level of affection. All save files should automatically apply the feature, but if you still can’t see the data and/or menu, try fighting any foe. Once the battle is concluded, the Attack Menu should become available. 

[b]4) Multiple fixes and tweaks of the localization packages.[/b] All reported typos and missing translation have been fixes/implemented. Localization of some rare routes (battle with manicaluu) has been updated. Missing synchronization of Ukrainian VA and the text has been fixed (a couple of rare routes/events).

[b]5) Dialogs skip mode now functions properly.[/b] Due to the integration of combat elements into our game, excessive use of dialogs skip button could cause certain bugs, glitches and even solf/hardlocks in certain scenarios. We’ve tested this function and corrected all critical issues and bugs we’ve encountered. However, we still recommend you save the game before skipping vast amounts of dialogs/scenarios to prevent any possible issues. 
Fixed bugs/issues:
• Fixed the bug that prevented the skip mode from being forcefully disengaged in certain scenarios and game modes (global map, static scenarios, etc.) and/or completely disabling it in settings. Now the skip mode can be enabled again once the event/scenario concludes.
• Now skip mode can’t be enabled in settings menu, but the function itself can be access during gameplay. Skipped dialogs counter is unique to every save file. 
• If the player enabled skip mode and encountered an event/scenario which temporary disabled it, the function will be automatically reinitiated once the even/scenario concludes. 

6) Multiple visual improvements and interface tweaks have been applied. We’ve also introduced the first set of hotkeys for better gameplay experience.

7) All reported bugs/glitches have been fixed.

[h3]All known plot-related inconsistencies regrading missing reaction of some characters to the events/decisions made will be fixed in the August update. [/h3]

The long-awaited continuation of the main story is coming next! We must complete the Chapter 1 for all classes to get prepared for the upcoming event we’ve planned. Oh, and what will it be? You will find out soon!

Thank you very much! See you in Nanraas!

[b]We would like to thank the players for their help in improving localization and finding bugs:[/b]
[b]Ippe A, In'ryaat, Oleg88, Lighting FLame, yanua555, KromSania, EMP![/b]

We’d better not jump to conclusions. If such a hooligan might have a backstory to tell. Do you remember some of the characters mentioning her father? OK-OK, no more spoilers! 
Also, Niravel is not simply a mindless Elveos’ minion, but tender and complex personality. Since many players liked her, we’ll unveil some of her past and continue her story in the upcoming update. If you still haven’t had an opportunity to speak with her near the cozy campfire, maybe it’s time to do it now?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/9b7cb44786245643fa04999f4cc0ecb1ee142245.jpg[/img]

[h2]More QoL changes, fixes and improvements[/h2]

We’ve also prepared multiple fixes, QoL changes, improvements and much-much more! Complete list of upcoming changes will be published in the Steam patch notes once the update goes live. Each idea and suggestion of our players is discussed and evaluated, so we’d like to thank you all very much for your valuable feedback and support!  The best of your suggestions and ideas will be implemented in the 
upcoming patches and updates!

One of the most important QoL improvement of the combat system will be the updated Azaries’ Diary that will display the combat characteristics of Azaries, her party mates and unlockable allies, including short description of the parameters that impact each value and the list of pros and cons of every attack type. 

For example:
1) Base attack value. This is the main attack value of the main character that increases with each level obtained.
2) Friendship bonus. This value is applied to the Azaries’ allies’ base attack value and depends on the affection level of the specific character. Affection level (level of friendship) can be increased during loyalty missions, side stories, by making certain decisions and/or interacting with the characters. 
3) Mastery level. This parameter affects Azaries’ attack and increases when she uses her offensive skills (the more often the skills is used, the higher its mastery level will be).
4) Difficulty level multiplier. This parameter affect the attack/defense of Azaries and her companions, as well as the parameters of the majority of foes. “Narration” difficulty allows to adjust the multiplier to balance the combat element of the game to your liking. “Classical Difficulty” and “Dangerous World” modes do not allow to alter the difficulty level multiplier and offer more hardcore combat.

Since some of the players requested the possibility to skip battles/disable combat system, we’ve been discussing possible changes within our team. Combat is the core element and one of the major distinguishing features of our game, which is deeply integrated into both the gameplay and the story, so completely disabling it will cut off a significant portion of story-based gameplay, so we decided to seek the alternatives. Thus, currently we’re offering our players a more flexible “Narration” mode, which lets everyone make the encounters more enjoyable and less stressful. Moreover, such control over the power of Azaries and her companions also makes it easier to check all available options in certain battles.

We’re planning to release the update in August, 2024.

Thank you very much! See you in Nanraas!

notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas! Thank you very much for supporting our game and helping us to develop it further! We appreciate your invaluable feedback, reported bugs and voiced suggestions! You’re helping us to polish the game and make it even more interesting and exciting for all the players!
 
A week has passed since the Early Access release of our game. We’ve been doing our best to fix all the reported bugs, glitches, typos and inconsistencies asap. Thanks to the hard work of our beta version testers, there were only few of them. Since now the current build of the game is stable and doesn’t require any serious tweaking/rebalancing, we’d like to share some future development plans with you. Some developers call it a “roadmap”, but due to the hilariously contagious practice of breaking the promises and failing the deadlines by some infamous teams, we’d better avoid this term.

[h2]Large sarantales- and nental-focused content update that will conclude Chapter 1[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/ec9bcc2d061ff167a8cca5ff34e6a7834b9e4bb7.jpg[/img]

Unfortunately, due to countless issues that include full-fledged war that’s raging all over our country and its impact on multiple aspects of our life (blackouts, unavailability of some equipment, air raid alerts and so on), we didn’t manage to finish and polish the second part of Chapter 1 (we mean Chapter 1 of the game, not the game itself) of two above-mentioned classes. The first large content update is planned to be released in July-August 2024. This update will deepen the differences between classes even more, thus eliminating most of the common features of the nental and sarantales routes, making them unique and self-sustained.

Also, we’re planning on implementing some Quality of Life (QoL) changes aimed at improving the gameplay, UI and controls in general. Thus, we’re currently working on the clickable screen that will be displaying Azaries’ current attack power value. This feature will let the players see all the parameters that positively and negatively impact Azaries’ attack power and use this knowledge to further improve this value by changing the setup, gear, equipping/discarding cards/artifacts/using potions, etc. Also, similar menu will be available in Azaries’ Diary in the pages of her allies and combat buddies, displaying valuable information about their attacks, skills, abilities. This feature will also clarify the impact of Azaries’ relationships with the characters on their combat effectiveness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/5883ce1ad5a3505e2c42e4d795b0d780910db559.jpg[/img]

After the first large content update, we’ll have to temporary prioritize one of the class routes over the other two to accelerate its development in terms of story writing, gameplay features implementation and new chapters integration. It doesn’t mean that we’re going to completely abandon the other classes for the time being, but we think that delivering a large portion of consistent, polished and well-balanced 3-to-4 hours long one class-exclusive story is better than releasing small bits of 20-to-30 minutes of all three classes storylines. Once the prioritized route is concluded, we’ll hold another poll to prioritize the content development and to focus on one of two remaining classes.

notes.title: Heralds of the Avirentes Chapter: 1 Wings of Change has officially been released
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas! The day we’ve all been waiting for has finally come! Heralds of the Avirentes Chapter: 1 Wings of Change has officially been released as the Steam Early Access game!

No more speculations, doubts, or fears – you can go and check out the game all by yourself! Currently, the game offers more than 30* hours of exciting adventures, branching dialogs with story-impacting choices, adrenaline-filled turn-based battles, amazing characters to interact with and much more! Azaries – the main character of the game – is naïve hatchling of the om’veri species (dragon-like sentient beings that inhabit the largest part of Nanraas). She is curious, kind-hearted and has a never-ending zeal for adventures. However, one fateful day changes her life forever. A series of inexplicable events, as well as her mysterious heritage, spells the beginning of the greatest adventure in her life! Thanks to the advanced system of choices and consequences, you can shape Azaries’ personality to your liking: she can become a talented but arrogant researcher capable of manipulating ancient constructs, cold-blooded assassin who can slay multiple foes without a second thought, a noble beholder of peace and justice, and much-much more! Affinity system allows Azaries build relationships with certain characters and NPCs thus making it possible to impact the surrounding world. Moreover, Azaries and her companions will encounter many foes and strangers and it’s up to you to decide on their fate! Nanraas opens its doors to everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/c7ebbde0748bb157fc20d7e4d357e97dde9e1814.jpg[/img]

Also, all currently available in-game content and mechanics are subject to change and improvement. All suggestions and pieces of advice regarding the possible ways of improving the game and any of its aspects will be carefully considered! We’re looking forward to hearing from you!
What’s next? First of all, we’d like to thank you all for your continued support and invaluable feedback! We’re planning to fix all encountered bugs, typos, and issues asap. The next stage would be the step-by-step integration of new content, as well as improvement of the existing one, introduction of the new mechanics and implementation of the best community ideas and suggestions into the game.

notes.title: Our plans for spring, updated release date and much more
Happy Saint Valentine’s Day!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas! Have you already prepared some great gifts for your loved ones? You still have a tiny bit of time to take care of pleasant surprises for them! Well, if you’re still in search of a perfect partner for yourself – worry not! Just spend the time with the person you like and feel the most comfortable to be with and, who knows, they might become your ideal love match! Happy Saint Valentine’s Day, folks!

There are several festivities in Nanraas that have similar customs and traditions. All of them are celebrated in Naaikos (spring), for it’s hard to find a more romantic time than the season of the awakening of nature and the first warm rays of Eorin that touch the hearts of every living creature around. The first holiday is called Tio’Rish – the great festivity of family and family life. This festival is usually celebrated by those who have already tied the knot and spent at least one chio’tai in peace and harmony. “Love not only your partner, but your family as a whole” – that’s what wise om’veri say about this holiday. There’s no place for selfishness and egoism in this day – even the most dedicated workaholics take a brake and spend time with their loved ones, children, and the closest relatives. Moreover, all the enterprises and even government institutions give their employees an official holiday.

Parents take their hatchlings and teenlings to amusement parks, camping sites, flight stations and sandy beaches to have as much fun as they can. Also, some special events such as concerts, fire shows, figure flights are held by local authorities and members of different families-oriented organizations. However, single om’veri without families and any intentions to have one in future are allowed to work during Tio’Rish. People call them “Sol’ma’verai” – “lonely souls”. These individuals idolize their careers and put their jobs above all. Sandy, most of them are destined to spend the rest of their lives alone, without any hope to find a partner and start a family.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/eec42626a52ba289b28b518fc9dccf3341a28b18.jpg[/img]

The second grand holiday is called Tar’Tarish – the festivity of love and friendship. All those who are in love or active seeking a partner prepare small gifts for their loved ones. This holiday is similar to the Saint Valentine’s Day in many ways and its patron is the Aegis of Love – Lan’kir. Despite not being a part of the Great Triumvirate of the Aegises, Lan’kir is worshiped by many young om’veri as the goddess of love, fertility, and family happiness. Tar’Tarish is the ideal day for a declaration of love, love confession and even marriage proposal. The most appreciated gift in this day is the special kind of candy that is made in the shape of egg and filled with a tasty liquor. But remember: such a candy can be given to person with whom you’re good friends or lovers. Otherwise, egg-shaped candy can be considered as mocking, gesture of disrespect and even sign of hostility and bulling. However, the color of such a candy has a very special mean. Thus, white color means friendship, red color is the sign of deep love and appreciation, but black color means that your partner is willing to break up with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/8c66c81601c80c8180da30d4b2f2c2c559a70554.jpg[/img]

Will Azaries find her true love during her adventures? Well, it’s all up to you! Our game features several possible romance options and each of them leads whether to a happy-ever-after ending or a total disaster, depending on Azaries’ choices, preferences, and participation in special events. Each character Azaries can enter relationship with has a sequence of special events and personal quests. Also, Azaries’ moral paradigm and attitude towards some particular character impacts her possible romance options. For example, some characters appreciate sentiments and zeal for justice, as well as a number of good deeds done in each city, while the others prefer cold-bloodedness, calculative nature and intentions to gain as much power and wealth as possible. Just remember: pay attention to your party mates and newly encountered characters. They always have something to share with you!

Another amazing feature of our game is the possibility to help some of your party mates to find love and happiness or turn their lives into the disaster. Each character that joins Azaries and her team is a personality with their own stories, desires, intentions and plans for future. From time to time, they will be interacting with each other and Azaries can help them get along well or stimulate the flames of their mutual hatred – everything is up to the player! Each decision made and each dialog option selected brings certain advantages and disadvantages – and always being “a knight in shining armor” is not always the best option.

Thank you very much! See you in Nanraas!

notes.title: Happy winter Holidays!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas! Christmas hustle and bustle is speeding up, so it’s finally time to think about pleasant chores and get some sweet presents for the loved ones. Soon our family will gather around the cozy fireplaces or Christmas trees to unwrap colorful boxes with exciting heartwarming surprises inside!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/550c5fa6172f337ee95080cadafa9dcff96c3312.png[/img]

Nanraas has also got a cycle of winter holidays that is so much expected by little hatchlings and adult om’veri alike – the Three Aegises Festivity and the Chio’nova.
Since the moment the first snow cover the roof the Tower of the Chronicler – the place where the oldest and the wisest of the om’veri records the historical chronicles of the current epoch in the Book of the Ancestors – the pleasant chores of the preparation for these two festivities begin. For the next 24 days the entire Nanraas looks like a beehive that is preparing for the holidays to come. Despite the multiple differences, our Christmas and New Year traditions have much in common with the celebration of the Three Aegises Festivity and the Chio’nova. Adult om’veri usually bring a pine tree to their homes and decorate it with colorful glass balls and sweets.

Since new chores and preparations for the festivities consume all the free time of the om’veri, most of the enterprises offer their workers a paid vacation called “The Three Aegises Fiesta”. Culmination of the festival is the grand celebration in the center of every town and city round Nanraas. Every om’verai gives the Aegis he/she was born under a small ceremonial pawmade present that varies from a small candy from a hatchling to a gigantic statue of the particular Aegis erected by a rich entrepreneur or politician. All the presents are left at the public shrines or family altars located inside living quarters. As the thanks for the offering, it is believed that each Aegis purifies the hearts of each om’veri allowing them to enter the new cycle of Veerima with all the sins atoned and grieves washed away. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/e3d6a0be3f8365ba2230c6d94c9af75c5d7953c5.png[/img]

Chio’nova is the festival of the cycle of Veerima change that occurs every year on the 368th day. Unlike The Three Aegises Festivity, Chi’nova is a holiday with a fixed date. Traditionally, the oriental region of Chyme-Calantre celebrates this festival especially pompously – since this is the second night of the year when it is forbidden to sleep, all the om’veri try to get charged with the positive energy that is rumored to fill the world. Nevertheless, the rest of the Chio’nova traditions remain the same: sweets, presents, family reunions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/be4b848d89f6f5ffac056a84c8aad056a211f74e.png[/img]

We wish you all happy winter Holidays! The next Chio’nova you will be meeting with Azaries, Gherstie, Ahros, Verolus and other awesome character of our game! Great news are coming soon! 

Thank you very much! See you in Nanraas!

*Chio’tai can be roughly translated as the “year”, where “chio” stands for “period of time” and “tai” means cycle.

notes.title: The official release date of the Heralds of the Avirentes Ch 1: Wings of Change
notes.content:
Some of you may say that VNDB features another release date – December 12th, 2023, and you will definitely have the point. However, registering the game without a release date is literary impossible, so we had to figure out a technical RD that was plausible and reflected the true state of development at that timeframe. We’ve thoroughly analyzed feedback gathered after the release of playable demo, our own time and effort required to polish the project, as well as the resources needed to implement VA and conduct proper quality check. Thus, the new release date has been decided. We tried to consider all the possible risks, including air raids, missile and drone attacks, blackouts, etc…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/3277a4410ab5eb4fa866d853950ad4369aadf7bc.jpg[/img]

After hours of brainstorming and discussing the roadmap of the game, we’ve come up with a conclusion that the post-winter period will be perfect for the early access release. The game is entering Steam Early Access on [b]March 26th, 2024[/b]!

We would also like to remind you that HotA can already offer 30 hours of solid involving gameplay that includes main story and some quality side quests. We’re currently working on save files compatibility, so you won’t have to start the game anew after patches/content updates.

Also, we’re planning on updating the playable demo to implement the upgraded combat system.
Thank you very much for your support! Your interest in the project in combination with your invaluable support make it all possible! Thanks to you we can keep the development up and rolling, work on the VO, translate the game into other languages and even cooperate with some great soundtrack makers! The greater your support is, the greater our game will be!

Thank you! See you in Nanraas!

notes.title: Happy Night of the Full Veerima!
notes.content:
You shouldn’t go to the magical forest in this particular season of the year... But it’s so tempting! Who knows what miracles you can see there and what mysteries you might unveil… Wise people say that it can change your life forever…
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas! We must admit that Halloween has always been one of our favorite holidays filled with mysteries and absolutely unique atmosphere of scary and yet fantastic atmosphere! You can hear “Trick-or-treat!” here and there, and the candies, lollipops and chocolates are given to the brave kids in their awesome costumes (and sometimes to adults as well!). At least, that’s how the western world celebrates it. In our country we’re still getting used to including Halloween into the list of our favorite festivities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/fdd7abd57a1dc1efb5bc37ea3c9579b6a74840c9.jpg[/img]

Full Veerima festivity in Nanraas is of the same importance as the Day of Holy Aegises. According to the traditions, om’veri decorate glowing little crystals with special runes, which can be translated as “Harmony”, “Peace”, and “Love”. Yellow and blue crystals are the most popular during this festival; they are used as decorations all over the habitats, for they embody the great mysteries of life and death as well as the status and hospitality of the om’veri who live in every particular cave. Thus, in this day even the citizens of little towns don’t want to run away from their small stuffy dwellings due to the magnificence of mysterious light produced by the crystals, which lets them feel the connection with the nature, spirits, and ancient traditions of their kind. Wise om’veri say that the brighter and more harmonious the house looks, the greater blessing the Bali’arnas – the Aegis of Life – will spell upon its owners.

Hatchlings and teenlings adore this festivity for endless sweets and gifts they receive from the adults. Oriental om’veri believe that the more kentecks you spend on your family and loved ones, the more taim’chei energy – the energy of happiness and prosperity – will fill every corner of the world to make the next year better than the previous one. However, only the presents and sweets that are truly desired by kids and relatives will add more taim’chei, not just any random purchased thing, so it is advised to ask them about their wishes beforehand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/f6297918ba3c06965664c3312e5f14a27affef9d.jpg[/img]

From the very morning om’veri start cooking delicious treats and making sweet drinks for their families and friends. It’s forbidden to fill this sacred day with hard labor, business affairs and noise of daily routine. Also, no one should argue or start quarrels, or they’ll call upon themselves the rage of the Amoran – the Aegis of Water – this magnificent deity is rumored to rest in Full Veerima Day. 

The night of the Full Veerima festival is also filled with lights and joy. All the Nanraas keeps celebrating it with their friends and families. The main dish on every table is the pumpkin filled with tasty, delicious mush. Each member of the family must eat at least one portion of the dish, or they’ll awaken the black energy of mu’uaru – the energy of misfortune, diseases, and death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833712/e1e0235acde54ae22053331d3a603c1714e77501.jpg[/img]

After the family dinner, costumed hatchlings and teenlings usually go “Trick-or-treating!” – asking the om’veri in their native villages, towns, and cities for sweet treats instead of pranking them and their families for greed and inhospitality. The brighter and more awkward the costume is, the higher is the chance of getting ultra rare and tasty candies! Funny outfits and makeup make everyone laugh, thus generating more taim’chei and expunging the mu’uaru negative energy. Everyone should go to bed with the first rays of Eorin not to let the dark forces possess their bodies and souls.

Do you enjoy celebrating Halloween?
Thank you very much! See you in Nanraas!

notes.title: Exploring Nanraas: Azaries Amnera
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorer of Nanraas! We’ve been constantly doing our best to deliver you’re the top-notch exciting content and the best gaming experience. Moreover, we’ve put our heart and soul into this wonderful game. However, the development process is not an easy stuff, especially if you’re willing to bring something unique and of a high quality for every gamer to judge. Thus, we decided to start the “Exploring Nanraas” series of developers’ diaries to let you get acquainted with this wonderful fictional world, its flora, fauna, and sentient species as well as with its rich history and lore. Also, some local phenomena and gameplay mechanics will be properly introduced and explained.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zWbLDVm.jpg[/img]

[h2]Introduction of Azaries[/h2]

Azaries Amnera – the main character of the game – is the best candidate to get to know better first, don’t you think? This charming om’verai with elegant gold hair and deep glowing purple eyes will be your avatar in the world of Nanraas. Two major periods of her life are depicted in the game: early childhood and prime of her youth. This isn’t a spoiler, because even the game poster depicts both iterations of Azaries.

[img]https://res.cloudinary.com/kutok/image/fetch/s--5yMyhRQ1--/c_limit%2Cf_auto%2Cfl_progressive%2Cq_auto%2Cw_1500/https://kutok.s3.amazonaws.com/uploads/articles/lvzghyu5ik1zc415vcm4.jpg[/img]

Azaries is an average female child of the om’veri race. She lives in a small provincial town of High Circles. She is pretty educated for her age; however, she doesn’t have many friends due to her conservative upbringing and peculiar interests. Instead of hitting the floor at the parties and poisoning her body with gallons of alcohol, Azaries prefers reading ancient long-forgotten books in some cozy hideouts, like the one in the Aquelles forest. Those few friends Azaries has got were carefully chosen and will remain loyal to her no matter what. Moreover, silver om’verai appreciates honesty and despises lies. She is known in High Circles as one of the most good-natured and sincerest persons always ready to give a paw to anyone who is in need of her help.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kWJamR5.png[/img]

One day Azaries’ world has been turned upside down and her life has changed forever. She found a strange looking crystal in the forest. Her expertise allowed her to state that it was an ancient artifact created decades ago – in the era of Reunification Wars. That epoch of darkness is known for the Great Ruin it had brought to the lands of Nanraas, as well as for the excessive use of countless extremely advanced and dangerous technologies which the race of om’veri banned shortly after the truce was established. The majority of the om’veri can’t active and wield the artifacts of the past, but the crystal has awakened in Azaries’ paws and unleashed its tremendous power upon her foes. The mysterious person who had been watching our heroin from the shows was pleasantly surprised and planned her next move…

[img]https://res.cloudinary.com/kutok/image/fetch/s--9RLaiN48--/c_limit%2Cf_auto%2Cfl_progressive%2Cq_auto%2Cw_1500/https://kutok.s3.amazonaws.com/uploads/articles/jn3p8p1bagfpg7nfkdo6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Creating Azaries[/h2]

Believe me or not, but I’ve been an average furry artist. I didn’t have a clear goal of creating a game or a universe of my own. Thus, I’ve just been drawing dragon-like character for my own pleasure. The firs concept of Azaries was created back in 2013. Azaries from 2013 has amost nothing in common with the current cheerful main character of the game except for some basic features, such as the general  color scheme, purple eyes, horns and spikes.
Year 2016 brought some drastic changes of my drawing style, which impacted the looks of Azaries to the very core. (2). More detailed scales, blond hair, specific form of the scull and horns – all these features have changed the very image of this character forever. After graduating from the university, I’ve finally worked out the more or less consistent concept of the future game. In 2018, Azaries received the final update of her appearance. (3) Thus, five years of trial-and-error made Azaries a truly unique recognizable character ready to explore the brand-new world of Nanraas!

Azaries’ appearance is indivisible connected with her character traits and the main story of the game. For example, her eyes are of an extremely rare purple color. This color is so rare among the om’veri that some even call it “The Curse of the Ancients”. However, Azaries has never paid attention to this curious fact, until… Well, you’ve got to find it out yourself soon enough! We’ll only give you a hint: this feature of her looks is not just cool design, but an important element of the lore and game mechanics. 
Azaries’ amazing blond hair and determined gaze complete the vivid picture of a true leader. Moreover, om’veri with the silver and white scales are believed to contain the great potential deep inside. However, it requires considerable zeal and effort to be unlocked. 
It's all up to you: you can make Azaries the great hero… or the great villain!

[img]https://res.cloudinary.com/kutok/image/fetch/s--RRXTni9Q--/c_limit%2Cf_auto%2Cfl_progressive%2Cq_auto%2Cw_1500/https://kutok.s3.amazonaws.com/uploads/articles/hadh36hn5g4eklrxy45k.jpg[/img]

In the beginning of her story, Azaries has a certain setup of character traits, which reflects the author’s vision of her personality – so-called “story canon”. However, the game features real RPG-elements, which extend beyond the simple leveling-and-upgrading system like in the majority of modern linear games that claim themselves to be called “RPGs”. The player choses Azaries’ actions and/or dialog branches in the crucial points of her adventure. Each option can potentially impact her personality, party mates, main story, substories and the world of Nanraas itself. For example, killing your foes and lying to NPCs and allies will enrage some of Azaries’ companions and certain character causing conflicts, extra battles and even death of some of her companions. Nevertheless, the other characters will definitely like such violence and pure chaos providing Azaries with useful items, combat assistance and even joining her during substories. Each playthrough is unique and filled with exciting discoveries and numerous ways to accomplish your goals.

Each decision made will change Azaries karma towards one of the following archetypes: Kindness, Balance, or Aggression. Each of them provides certain bonuses and handicaps. For example, Azaries of a “Kind” archetype will receive reputation and persuasion bonuses, discounts t shops and access to peaceful ways of solving some conflicts, nonetheless, she won’t be able to exploit perks of the “Aggressive” archetype, such as intimidation, brute force, and sheer violence. “Balanced” archetype is hard to maintain, but it sometimes offers truly unique options during in-game events and quests.

Thank you very much! See you in Nanraas!

notes.title: Large demo update is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of Nanraas! Not a long time ago the playable demo of our demo was released, but we’re still receiving valuable feedback and suggestions from our community! We’ve been so inspired by your interest in our project and tons of great ideas you’ve been sharing with us on our discord channel, so we’re back at improving the demo and some of the best pieces of advice will even make it into the main game!
First of all, we’d like to thank you for your time and effort – your invaluable feedback can hardly be overestimated. We’ve already fixed all known bugs and improved the overall quality of the demo. Moreover, some more exciting changes are on their way!

[b]This update includes the following changes/fixes/content updates:[/b]
1) Ukrainian localization has been updated. All known typos/inconsistencies have been fixed. Also, we’ve improved the VO sync in some dialogs.
2) Balance improvements. Some players found it confusing that in the description of some attacks/skills certain numbers (example: “Attack A does 40 damage”) do not match the actual damage dealt to the foes (real damage dealt is 6-7). First of all, these are the base “bare” values of attacks/skills which are yet to be used by the game in certain formulas with the set of other values (attack types, base attack multiplier, target’s defense, def type and so on), thus Azaries won’t deal 40 pure damage points to the majority of the enemies. We agree that it may sound confusing, so we’ve decided to change the basics of displaying the possible damage of offensive and defensive skills and abilities to make it clearer and more evident. At the moment, we’re discussing the possible variants. In future updates, this issue will be fixed.
3) UI tweaks and small bugs fixes.

Once the demo meets our highest standards (it is now, but there’re no limits to perfection) we’ll implement the most important changes to the main game and even introduce the new mechanics suggested by our dear players!

Due to the nature of some changes implemented into the demo, we kindly ask you to reinstall the game or use the “check game files” feature in order to manually update the game. We’re currently experiencing some issues with Steam Autoupdate mechanism. No worries! We’re working on resolving this issue.

Thank you very much! See you in Nanraas!

notes.title: Demo version has been released on Steam!
notes.content:
Greetings, dear guests! The moment we’ve been looking for has finally come! Demo version of our game “Heralds of the Avirentes Ch.1 Wings of Change” is available for download! Anyone can play it for free!

The demo version of the game offers up to 7 hours of unforgettable adventures around the picturesque places of the fictional world of Nanraas! The game also features amazing visuals and full Ukrainian localization and even the voice over! Young charming Azaries is ready to tell you the story of her great adventures!

You can play the Prologue and Chapter 1 with minimal restrictions! Among the main gameplay features there are exciting and breathtaking main story, advanced combat system with a number of tactical elements, character affinity and loyalty system, substories, errands and much more! Azaries can choose one of three available classes and each time the story will feature class-unique elements, events, quests, errands, and even exclusive characters. Also, each class offers substantial impact on the main story!

[h2]Short description of the game[/h2]

A small silver-haired om’verai Azaries has been enjoying the first truly warm days of spring in her favorite spot within the local forest. She was dreaming about the great adventures she read about in her favorite books while bathing in the golden rays of the sun. She had no idea her fate was about to change… Soon she will find herself involved in a series of events that will change her life and the entire world of Nanraas forever. Will she unveil the mysteries of her origin, unique purple eyes, and unusual abilities, thanks to which she can command the ancient long-forgotten mechanisms and constructs? It’s all up to you! Uncover the truth and save or destroy the world!

Aside the thrilling mysteries of the main story, game features branching dialog system with multiple choices. Each of them can potentially impact Azaries’ relationships with other characters, sudatories, errands and even occurrence of some particular events and cataclysms! The player can carefully build up the affinity with other characters, earn their loyalty and trust to unlock new dialogs, interactions and combat options, or quarrel with them, disrespect their ideals, and, as the result, confront some of the NPCs deciding their fate and future! Carefully crafted turn-based combat with tactical elements won’t let you get bored during you travels! Explore Nanraas at your own pace and discover its secrets!

[b]If you like our game, please consider adding it to your steam wishlist! We’re doing our best to deliver you the best content and gameplay experience! We’re always happy to receive your feedback and read your comments and suggestions![/b]

VO is done by Melvoice team

[h2]Thank you very mush! See you in Nanraas![/h2]
